data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), after an enemy unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any of your **GREY KNIGHTS** units makes a **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**.

**Target:** A **GREY KNIGHTS** unit of yours that the enemy unit was in Engagement Range of, and that is now **[unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)**.

**Effect:** If the unit has **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)**, you can place it into **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**.
